tools.name: run_tool_batch
tools.description:
Run one or more tools in order. Each operation has a tool name and an args object.

Supported tools and arguments:
- list_files: path
- read_file: path
- write_file: path, content
- do_a_targetted_edit: path, line_range ('start,end'), content
- search_file: name, optional drive (string array or null), optional extension (string or null)
- open_file: path (an existing file path)
- rename_file: path, new_name
- run_a_generic_command: cmd(Provide the command itself as the cmd argument; do not wrap the entire command in extra quotes. JSON escaping is separate from shell quoting: JSON requires each path backslash to be written as \, and quotes inside a JSON string as ". After JSON parsing, the command must contain ordinary single backslashes and shell quotes, with no literal backslash before the quote.)

- run_a_vbs_script: script(use this for performing UI actions in the system like clicking, typing, etc) 
- search_the_internet: query

Each tool receives its own arguments. Results and errors are returned per step; an error does not stop later operations. One confirmation authorizes the full batch, including commands or scripts, file changes, application launches, and internet searches. The batch tool cannot call itself.

tool.description: Name of one of the supported tools listed above.

args.description: Arguments for the selected tool, using the parameter names listed above.

returns.description: One ordered result per operation. Successful steps contain a result; failed steps contain an error.
